#revision figures / plotting for Figures 1-4 and supplementary Figures 1-17

#Figure 1:

```{r}

# Figure 1 

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(sf)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)


# -------- Load ancestry + date data --------

dates <- read.table(
  "../final_figures_data/allentoft_dates_041725.txt",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

ancestry <- read.table(
  "../final_figures_data/qpadm_output_global_ancestry.txt",
  header = TRUE
)

colnames(dates) <- c("ID", "Age")
colnames(ancestry) <- c("ID", "Ancestry")

dates$Age <- as.numeric(gsub(",", "", dates$Age))

main_data <- merge(dates, ancestry, by = "ID")
main_data$Group <- "ADMIXED"


# -------- Reference panel --------

panel <- read.table(
  "../final_figures_data/flare.ref.panel",
  header = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
colnames(panel) <- c("ID", "Label")

panel_with_dates <- merge(panel, dates, by = "ID")

panel_with_dates$Ancestry <- ifelse(panel_with_dates$Label == "neo", 0,
                                    ifelse(panel_with_dates$Label == "hg", 1, NA))

panel_with_dates$Group <- ifelse(panel_with_dates$Label == "neo", "FARMER",
                                 ifelse(panel_with_dates$Label == "hg", "HG", NA))

panel_with_dates <- panel_with_dates[!is.na(panel_with_dates$Group), ]


# -------- Combine --------

combined <- rbind(
  main_data[, c("ID", "Age", "Ancestry", "Group")],
  panel_with_dates[, c("ID", "Age", "Ancestry", "Group")]
)

admixed_data <- combined %>% filter(Group == "ADMIXED")


# -------- Map sample metadata --------

allentoft_excel_data <- read_excel(
  "../final_figures_data/allentoft_full_data.xlsx",
  skip = 10
)

admixed_samples <- read.table(
  "../final_figures_data/mneo_keep_fam.txt"
)$V2

source_samples <- read.table(
  "../final_figures_data/flare.ref.panel"
)

neo_samples <- source_samples$V1[source_samples$V2 == "neo"]
hg_samples  <- source_samples$V1[source_samples$V2 == "hg"]

filtered_data <- allentoft_excel_data %>%
  filter(`Individual ID` %in% c(admixed_samples, neo_samples, hg_samples)) %>%
  mutate(
    Group = case_when(
      `Individual ID` %in% admixed_samples ~ "ADMIXED",
      `Individual ID` %in% neo_samples ~ "FARMER",
      `Individual ID` %in% hg_samples ~ "HG"
    ),
    latitude = as.numeric(Latitude),
    longitude = as.numeric(Longitude)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(latitude))


# -------- World map --------

world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")



# Define purple gradient
purple_gradient <- scales::gradient_n_pal(c("#dcd6f7", "#4b0082"))

# Scale and invert age for color gradient
admixed_data <- admixed_data %>%
  mutate(
    Age_scaled = (Age - min(Age)) / (max(Age) - min(Age)),
    Age_scaled_inv = 1 - Age_scaled,
    color_by_age = purple_gradient(Age_scaled_inv)
  )

# Stronger colors for groups
colors <- c(
  "FARMER" = "#E69F00",
  "HG"     = "#009E73"
)

# Merge age into map data
filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
  left_join(admixed_data %>% select(ID, Age),
            by = c("Individual ID" = "ID")) %>%
  mutate(
    shape_final = case_when(
      Group == "FARMER" ~ 15,
      Group == "HG" ~ 17,
      Group == "ADMIXED" ~ 16,
      TRUE ~ 16
    )
  )

# Base theme
base_theme <- theme_classic() + 
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "plain")
  )


# -------- Panel A --------

p1 <- ggplot(data = world) +
  geom_sf(fill = "gray80", color = "white") +
  
  # FARMER
  geom_point(
    data = filtered_data %>% filter(Group == "FARMER"),
    aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, shape = "Farmer"),
    color = "#E69F00",
    size = 2,   alpha = 0.7 
  ) +
  
  # HG
  geom_point(
    data = filtered_data %>% filter(Group == "HG"),
    aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, shape = "Hunter-Gatherer"),
    color = "#009E73",
    size = 2,   alpha = 0.7 
  ) +
  
    # ADMIXED (gradient)
  geom_point(
    data = filtered_data %>% filter(Group == "ADMIXED"),
    aes(x = longitude, y = latitude, color = Age),
    shape = 16,
    size = 2,   alpha = 0.85 
  ) +
  
  
  scale_color_gradient(
  low = "#dcd6f7",
  high = "#4b0082",
  name = "Date (years BP)",
  guide = guide_colorbar(
    title.theme = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(t = 25))
  )
) +
  
  # the legend for Farmer/HG
  scale_shape_manual(
  values = c("Farmer" = 15, "Hunter-Gatherer" = 17),
  name = NULL,
  guide = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(
      color = c("#E69F00", "#009E73")
    )
  )
) +
  
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-11, 37), ylim = c(35, 61)) +
  xlab("Longitude") + ylab("Latitude") +
  base_theme +
theme(
  legend.position = "right",
  legend.box = "vertical"
)
  


# -------- Panel B --------

p2 <- ggplot(admixed_data, aes(x = Age, y = Ancestry, color = Age)) +
  geom_point(size = 2,   alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  scale_color_gradient(
    low = "#dcd6f7",
    high = "#4b0082",
    name = "Date (years BP)"
  ) +
  base_theme +
  labs(
    x = "Average Date (years BP)",
    y = "Hunter-Gatherer Ancestry"
  ) +
theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 1, 5)  
  )


# -------- Combine + save --------

final_plot <- (p1 | p2) +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = theme(
      plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      plot.margin = margin(0, 0, -20, 0)
    )
  ) &
  theme(plot.tag.position = c(0.06, 1.2))


ggsave(
  "revision_Figure1.pdf",
  final_plot,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 3
)


```

#Figure 2:

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)



colors <- c(
  FARMER = "#808080",
  HG = "#808080",
  ADMIXED = "#9467bd",
  simplai = "#e377c2",
  ancestry_hmm = "#1f77b4",
  ancestry_paths = "#ff7f0e",
  mosaic = "#2ca02c",
  rfmix = "#d62728",
  recombmix = "#B8860B",   # dark goldenrod
  gnomix = "#8B4513"       # saddle brown
)


# Number of datasets
num_datasets <- as.numeric(9)

# Paths to each method's ancestry file
dataset_paths <- c("../final_figures_data/7v3_admixture.txt", "../final_figures_data/7v3_mosaic_global.txt", "../final_figures_data/ancestry_paths_output_global_ancestry.txt", "../final_figures_data/7v7_ancestry_hmm_global.txt", "../final_figures_data/7v7_rfmix_global_ancestry.txt","../final_figures_data/7v3_simplai_output_global_ancestry.txt", "../final_figures_data/qpadm_output_global_ancestry.txt", "../final_figures_data/recombmix_output_global_ancestry.txt", "../final_figures_data/gnomix_output_global_ancestry.txt")


# Method names
dataset_names <- c("imputed_admixture", "mosaic", "ancestry_paths", "ancestry_hmm", "rfmix", "simplai", "qpadm", "recombmix", "gnomix")

# Function to read and return data with method name
read_and_process <- function(file_path, method_name) {
  df <- read.table(file_path, header = TRUE)
  colnames(df) <- c("sample", paste0("global_ancestry_", method_name))
  return(df)
}

# Read all datasets into a list
dataset_list <- list()

for (i in 1:num_datasets) {
  dataset_list[[i]] <- read_and_process(dataset_paths[i], dataset_names[i])
}

# Combine all into one dataframe, spread by method
combined_df <- reduce(dataset_list, function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "sample"))

# Just select the columns we want (they already have the right names)
combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  select(sample, starts_with("global_ancestry_"))

# Drop any rows with NA values
combined_df <- na.omit(combined_df)

# A named vector to rename methods for plot titles
rename_methods <- c(
  imputed_admixture = "ADMIXTURE (7v3)",
  rfmix = "RFMix (7v7, 0.9)",
  simplai = "simpLAI (7v3)",
  mosaic = "Mosaic (7v3, 0.9)",
  ancestry_paths = "AncestralPaths (7v48)",
  ancestry_hmm = "Ancestry HMM (7v7, 0.9)",
  qpadm = "qpAdm",
  recombmix = "Recomb-Mix (7v7)",
  gnomix = "Gnomix (7v7)"
)

# Set base font size scaled to new size (was 16 before, let's reduce slightly)
base_font_size <- 10

qpAdm_vals <- combined_df[["global_ancestry_qpadm"]]

#----------------------------------------------------------
# Compute RMSE of each method vs qpAdm
#----------------------------------------------------------

methods_to_score <- setdiff(dataset_names, "qpadm")

rmse_table <- map_dfr(methods_to_score, function(method) {
  y_vals <- combined_df[[paste0("global_ancestry_", method)]]
  rmse_val <- sqrt(mean((y_vals - qpAdm_vals)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  data.frame(
    method = method,
    method_label = rename_methods[[method]],
    RMSE = rmse_val
  )
})

# Order: ADMIXTURE first (as before), then remaining methods lowest -> highest RMSE
admixture_row <- rmse_table %>% filter(method == "imputed_admixture")
other_rows <- rmse_table %>% filter(method != "imputed_admixture") %>% arrange(RMSE)

rmse_table_ordered <- bind_rows(admixture_row, other_rows)

# Print to console
print(rmse_table_ordered)

# Write out the RMSE table
write.csv(
  rmse_table_ordered %>% select(Method = method_label, RMSE),
  file = "revision_Figure2_RMSE_table.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Plot order follows the same ordering as the RMSE table
plot_order <- rmse_table_ordered$method

#----------------------------------------------------------
# Build plots in RMSE order
#----------------------------------------------------------

plots <- list()

for (method in plot_order) {
    y_vals <- combined_df[[paste0("global_ancestry_", method)]]

    df_plot <- data.frame(qpadm = qpAdm_vals, method_val = y_vals)

    r_val <- cor(df_plot$qpadm, df_plot$method_val, use = "complete.obs")
    r_text <- sprintf("R = %.2f", r_val)
    
    #delta:
     delta_val <- mean(abs(df_plot$method_val - df_plot$qpadm), na.rm = TRUE)
    delta_text <- sprintf("Δ = %.2f", delta_val)
    
        #slope of best-fit line
    fit <- lm(method_val ~ qpadm, data = df_plot)
    beta_val <- coef(fit)[2]
    beta_text <- sprintf("β = %.2f", beta_val)

    method_label <- rename_methods[[method]]
    if (is.null(method_label)) method_label <- tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", method))

    point_color <- if (method == "imputed_admixture") {
      colors["ADMIXED"]
    } else {
      colors[[method]] %||% "steelblue"
    }

    p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = qpadm, y = method_val)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.8, color = point_color, size = 2) +  # adjust point size if needed
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "firebrick", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.2) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
          annotate("text",
             x = 0.00, y = 0.60,
             label = bquote(R == .(round(r_val, 2))),
             hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text",
             x = 0.00, y = 0.50,
             label = bquote(beta == .(round(beta_val, 2))),
             hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text",
             x = 0.30, y = 0.08,
             label = bquote(Delta == .(round(delta_val, 2))),
             hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
      
      labs(
        x = "qpAdm",
        y = "Global Ancestry",
        title = method_label
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = base_font_size) +
      theme(
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.5),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_font_size + 1, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
        axis.title = element_text(size = base_font_size + 2),
        axis.text = element_text(size = base_font_size, color = "black"),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
      ) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 0.45), ylim = c(0, 0.7))

    plots[[length(plots) + 1]] <- p
}

# Save plot grid as PDF with new size
# 8 methods plotted, ordered by RMSE (ADMIXTURE first) -> 4 columns x 2 rows
final_plot <- plot_grid(plotlist = plots, ncol = 4, labels = NULL)

ggsave("revision_Figure2.pdf", final_plot, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```


#Figure 3:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)

# ============================================================
# COLORS (same palette used in Figure 2)
# ============================================================
colors <- c(
  FARMER = "#808080",
  HG = "#808080",
  ADMIXED = "#9467bd",
  simplai = "#e377c2",
  ancestry_hmm = "#1f77b4",
  ancestry_paths = "#ff7f0e",
  mosaic = "#2ca02c",
  rfmix = "#d62728",
  recombmix = "#B8860B",   # dark goldenrod
  gnomix = "#8B4513"       # saddle brown
)

# ============================================================
# STEP 1: Recompute the Figure 2 RMSE-vs-qpAdm ordering.
# This is what decides panel order in the new Figure 3 -- we
# reuse it exactly rather than re-deriving/hardcoding it, so the
# two figures can never drift out of sync if the underlying data
# changes.
# ============================================================
num_datasets <- 9

dataset_paths <- c(
  "../final_figures_data/7v3_admixture.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/7v3_mosaic_global.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/ancestry_paths_output_global_ancestry.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/7v7_ancestry_hmm_global.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/7v7_rfmix_global_ancestry.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/7v3_simplai_output_global_ancestry.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/qpadm_output_global_ancestry.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/recombmix_output_global_ancestry.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/gnomix_output_global_ancestry.txt"
)

dataset_names <- c("imputed_admixture", "mosaic", "ancestry_paths", "ancestry_hmm",
                    "rfmix", "simplai", "qpadm", "recombmix", "gnomix")

read_and_process <- function(file_path, method_name) {
  df <- read.table(file_path, header = TRUE)
  colnames(df) <- c("sample", paste0("global_ancestry_", method_name))
  return(df)
}

dataset_list <- list()
for (i in 1:num_datasets) {
  dataset_list[[i]] <- read_and_process(dataset_paths[i], dataset_names[i])
}

combined_df <- reduce(dataset_list, function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "sample")) %>%
  select(sample, starts_with("global_ancestry_")) %>%
  na.omit()

qpAdm_vals <- combined_df[["global_ancestry_qpadm"]]
methods_to_score <- setdiff(dataset_names, "qpadm")

rmse_table <- map_dfr(methods_to_score, function(method) {
  y_vals <- combined_df[[paste0("global_ancestry_", method)]]
  rmse_val <- sqrt(mean((y_vals - qpAdm_vals)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  data.frame(method = method, RMSE = rmse_val)
})

# Same logic as Figure 2: ADMIXTURE first, everything else by
# ascending RMSE. In Figure 2, admixture_row becomes a scatter
# panel; here it becomes the legend panel instead.
other_rows <- rmse_table %>% filter(method != "imputed_admixture") %>% arrange(RMSE)

# This is the panel order for the new Figure 3 (after the key).
# It now includes ancestry_paths, since it's scored in Figure 2
# just like every other method.
focal_order <- other_rows$method

print(focal_order)

# ============================================================
# STEP 2: Load local-ancestry correlation matrices
# ============================================================
cor_10kb    <- read.table("../final_figures_data/LA_correlation_matrix_binsize_10kb.txt")
cor_100kb   <- read.table("../final_figures_data/LA_correlation_matrix_binsize_100kb.txt")
cor_1000kb  <- read.table("../final_figures_data/LA_correlation_matrix_binsize_1000kb.txt")
cor_10000kb <- read.table("../final_figures_data/LA_correlation_matrix_binsize_10000kb.txt")

cor_10000kb[cor_10000kb < 0] <- 0

bin_sizes <- c(10, 100, 1000, 10000)
cor_list <- list("10" = cor_10kb, "100" = cor_100kb, "1000" = cor_1000kb, "10000" = cor_10000kb)

# All 7 methods that appear as rows/cols in the correlation
# matrices -- ancestry_paths was already here as a comparison
# column, it just never got its own focal panel before.
cor_methods <- c("rfmix", "ancestry_paths", "ancestry_hmm", "simplai", "mosaic", "gnomix", "recombmix")
colors_filtered <- colors[names(colors) %in% cor_methods]

# Labels reused from Figure 2's rename_methods, trimmed to the
# methods that live in this figure.
label_map <- c(
  rfmix          = "RFMix (7v7)",
  mosaic         = "Mosaic (7v3)",
  simplai        = "simpLAI (7v3)",
  ancestry_hmm   = "Ancestry HMM (7v7)",
  gnomix         = "Gnomix (7v7)",
  recombmix      = "Recomb-Mix (7v7)",
  ancestry_paths = "AncestralPaths (7v48)"
)

# ============================================================
# STEP 3: Helper to build the correlation-vs-binsize data for
# one focal method (unchanged from the original script)
# ============================================================
build_corr_df <- function(focal_method) {
  focal_name <- sub("^AVG_", "", focal_method)
  other_methods <- setdiff(names(colors_filtered), focal_name)

  result <- data.frame()

  for (size in bin_sizes) {
    cor_mat <- cor_list[[as.character(size)]]
    req_cols <- paste0("AVG_", other_methods)

    missing_cols <- setdiff(req_cols, colnames(cor_mat))
    if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
      stop(paste("Missing columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
    }

    row_vals <- as.numeric(cor_mat[focal_method, req_cols])

    df <- data.frame(
      Method = other_methods,
      Correlation = row_vals,
      BinSize = size,
      Focal = focal_name
    )

    result <- rbind(result, df)
  }

  return(result)
}

# ============================================================
# STEP 4: Build one standalone panel per focal method (legend
# off), styled to match the Figure 2 panels
# ============================================================
base_font_size <- 10

build_focal_plot <- function(focal_bare_name) {
  focal_method <- paste0("AVG_", focal_bare_name)
  df <- build_corr_df(focal_method)
  df$Method <- factor(df$Method, levels = cor_methods)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = BinSize, y = Correlation, color = Method)) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors, breaks = cor_methods, labels = label_map[cor_methods]) +
    scale_x_log10(
      breaks = bin_sizes,
      labels = scales::trans_format("log10", scales::math_format(10^.x)),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.12))
    ) +
    ylim(-0.05, 0.7) +
    labs(x = "Bin Size (kb)", y = "Pearson Correlation", title = label_map[[focal_bare_name]]) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = base_font_size) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.5),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_font_size + 1, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_font_size + 2),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_font_size, color = "black"),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
}

focal_plots <- lapply(focal_order, build_focal_plot)

# ============================================================
# STEP 5: Build the "key" panel that replaces the ADMIXTURE slot
# ============================================================
legend_df <- data.frame(
  Method = factor(cor_methods, levels = cor_methods),
  BinSize = bin_sizes[1],
  Correlation = 0
)

legend_source <- ggplot(
  legend_df,
  aes(x = BinSize, y = Correlation, color = Method)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(aes(group = Method), linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors, breaks = cor_methods, labels = label_map[cor_methods], name = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_font_size) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = base_font_size)
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, linewidth = 1.2)))

legend_grob <- get_legend(legend_source)
key_plot <- ggdraw() + draw_grob(legend_grob)

# ============================================================
# STEP 6: Assemble in the same order/layout as Figure 2
# (key where ADMIXTURE was, then RMSE-ascending order, ncol = 4)
# ============================================================
plots_final <- c(list(key_plot), focal_plots)

final_plot <- plot_grid(plotlist = plots_final, ncol = 4, labels = NULL)

ggsave("revision_Figure3.pdf", final_plot, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```


#Figure 4: (python)

```{python}
#!/usr/bin/env python

"""
Combined figure: HG tract-length distribution (top-left, big panel) +
TRACTS comparison plots for 7 ancestry-inference methods.

Clockwise from top-right:
Right column (rows 0-3, col 3): Mosaic, RFMix, Gnomix, Recomb-Mix
Bottom row   (row 3, cols 0-2): AncestralPaths (col 0), Ancestry HMM (col 1),
simpLAI (col 2)
Shared corner (row 3, col 3)  : Recomb-Mix

Output: 5.5 x 5.5 in, all TRACTS panels identical squares, same axis range.
"""

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import matplotlib.lines as mlines
from matplotlib.transforms import blended_transform_factory
import os.path as path

from FancyPlot import FancyPlot


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Colors
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

COLORS = {
    'rfmix':          'red',
    'simplai':        '#e377c2',
    'mosaic':         'green',
    'gnomix':         '#8B4513',
    'recombmix':      '#B8860B',
    'ancestry_paths': '#ff7f0e',
    'ancestry_hmm':   '#1f77b4',
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Display names -- shared between the HG-plot method legend AND the
# individual TRACTS panel titles, so the two can never drift apart.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

DISPLAY_NAMES = {
    'rfmix':          'RFMix (7v7)',
    'simplai':        'simpLAI (7v3)',
    'mosaic':         'Mosaic (7v3)',
    'gnomix':         'Gnomix (7v7)',
    'recombmix':      'Recomb-Mix (7v7)',
    'ancestry_paths': 'AncestralPaths (7v48)',
    'ancestry_hmm':   'Ancestry HMM (7v7)',
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# T= values (generations) shown inside each TRACTS panel
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

T_GENS = {
    'rfmix':          10.3,
    'simplai':        41.0,
    'mosaic':         6.5,
    'recombmix':      33.3,
    'ancestry_paths': 9.1,
    'ancestry_hmm':   49.6,
    'gnomix':         16.4,
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared axis limits for ALL 7 TRACTS panels
#
# Set TRACTS_YLIM_TOP to a float (e.g. 5000) to lock the y ceiling.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------

TRACTS_XLIM     = (0, 250)
TRACTS_YLIM_BOT = 0.92
TRACTS_YLIM_TOP = None


# ==================================================================
# PART 1 -- HG tract-length distribution
# ==================================================================

def build_hg_plot_data(hg_file):

    hg_tracts = pd.read_csv(hg_file, sep=r'\s+')

    # 60 log-spaced bins, 0.5-1000 cM
    bin_edges   = np.logspace(np.log10(0.5), np.log10(1000), 60)
    bin_starts  = bin_edges[:-1]
    bin_ends    = bin_edges[1:]
    bin_centers = (bin_starts + bin_ends) / 2

    filtered = hg_tracts[hg_tracts['tract_length_cm'] > 0].copy()

    filtered['bin_idx'] = (
        np.digitize(
            filtered['tract_length_cm'],
            bin_edges,
            right=False
        ) - 1
    )

    filtered = filtered[
        (filtered['bin_idx'] >= 0) &
        (filtered['bin_idx'] < len(bin_centers))
    ]

    rename_map = {
        'ancestry_hmm_haplotypes': 'ancestry_hmm'
    }

    filtered['Source'] = filtered['Source'].replace(rename_map)

    counts = (
        filtered.groupby(['Source', 'bin_idx'])
        .size()
        .reset_index(name='count')
    )

    totals = (
        counts.groupby('Source')['count']
        .sum()
        .rename('total_count')
    )

    counts = counts.join(totals, on='Source')

    counts['proportion'] = (
        counts['count'] / counts['total_count']
    )

    counts['bin_center'] = (
        bin_centers[counts['bin_idx'].values]
    )

    empirical = (
        counts[
            ['Source', 'bin_center', 'proportion']
        ]
        .rename(columns={'proportion': 'value'})
        .copy()
    )

    empirical['type'] = 'empirical'

    # Theoretical curves (p_hg = 0.4)
    p_hg = 0.4
    T_values = range(10, 201, 5)

    theory_rows = []

    for T in T_values:

        lam = (T * (1 - p_hg)) / 100.0

        probs = (
            np.exp(-lam * bin_starts)
            - np.exp(-lam * bin_ends)
        )

        for c, p in zip(bin_centers, probs):

            theory_rows.append(
                {
                    'Source': f'Theory T={T}',
                    'bin_center': c,
                    'value': p,
                    'T_value': T
                }
            )

    theoretical = pd.DataFrame(theory_rows)

    # log scale needs positive values
    theoretical = theoretical[
        theoretical['value'] > 0
    ]

    return empirical, theoretical


def draw_hg_plot(
    ax,
    empirical,
    theoretical,
    x_limits,
    y_limits
):

    from matplotlib.ticker import NullLocator

    highlight_T = [10, 20, 50, 100, 200]

    # Theory curves
    target_y = 10 ** (-4.8)
    log_target = np.log10(target_y)

    def find_crossing(sub):

        xs = sub["bin_center"].values
        log_ys = np.log10(sub["value"].values)

        below = np.where(log_ys <= log_target)[0]

        if len(below) == 0:
            return xs[-1], sub["value"].values[-1]

        if below[0] == 0:
            return xs[0], sub["value"].values[0]

        i1 = below[0]
        i0 = i1 - 1

        x0, x1 = xs[i0], xs[i1]
        y0, y1 = log_ys[i0], log_ys[i1]

        frac = (log_target - y0) / (y1 - y0)

        x_cross = x0 + frac * (x1 - x0)

        return x_cross, target_y

    stagger_y = {
        200: 10 ** -4.8,
        100: 10 ** -4.6,
        50:  10 ** -4.4
    }

    for T in highlight_T:

        sub = theoretical[
            theoretical["T_value"] == T
        ].sort_values("bin_center")

        sub = sub[
            sub["bin_center"] <= 250
        ]

        if len(sub) == 0:
            continue

        ax.plot(
            sub["bin_center"],
            sub["value"],
            color="black",
            lw=1.0,
        )

        x_at_target, y_at_target = find_crossing(sub)

        label_y = stagger_y.get(
            T,
            y_at_target
        )

        ax.text(
            x_at_target + 5,
            label_y,
            f"T={T}",
            fontsize=7,
            ha="left",
            va="center",
        )

    # Empirical points
    for source in empirical["Source"].unique():

        sub = empirical[
            empirical["Source"] == source
        ].sort_values("bin_center")

        ax.scatter(
            sub["bin_center"],
            sub["value"],
            color=COLORS[source],
            marker="^",
            s=35,
            alpha=0.85,
        )

    ax.set_xlim(0, 250)
    ax.set_xscale("linear")

    ax.set_yscale("log")
    ax.set_ylim(y_limits)

    ax.set_xticks(
        [0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250]
    )

    ax.set_xlabel("")
    ax.set_ylabel(
        "Proportion",
        fontsize=8
    )

    ax.tick_params(labelsize=7)

    # only major grid
    ax.grid(
        True,
        which="major",
        color="0.88",
        lw=0.5
    )

    ax.grid(
        False,
        which="minor"
    )

    ax.xaxis.set_minor_locator(
        NullLocator()
    )

    ax.yaxis.set_minor_locator(
        NullLocator()
    )

    # Title
    ax.set_title(
        "Hunter-Gatherer Tract Lengths",
        fontsize=9,
        fontweight="normal",
        pad=6,
    )

    # ---- Legend 1: HG / Farmer ----

    shape_legend = [
        mlines.Line2D(
            [],
            [],
            color="black",
            marker="^",
            linestyle="none",
            markersize=4,
            label="Hunter-Gatherer"
        ),
        mlines.Line2D(
            [],
            [],
            color="black",
            marker="s",
            linestyle="none",
            markersize=4,
            label="Farmer"
        ),
    ]

    leg1 = ax.legend(
        handles=shape_legend,
        frameon=False,
        fontsize=6,
        loc="upper left",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.58, 1.0),
    )

    ax.add_artist(leg1)

    # ---- Legend 2: method + color ----

    method_handles = [
        mlines.Line2D(
            [],
            [],
            color=COLORS[key],
            marker="^",
            linestyle="none",
            markersize=4,
            label=DISPLAY_NAMES[key]
        )
        for key in COLORS
    ]

    ax.legend(
        handles=method_handles,
        frameon=False,
        fontsize=6,
        loc="upper left",
        bbox_to_anchor=(0.58, 0.86),
    )


# ==================================================================
# PART 2 -- TRACTS panel for a single method
# ==================================================================

def draw_tracts_panel(
    ax,
    input_dir,
    method_key,
    show_xlabel,
    show_ylabel
):

    color = COLORS[method_key]
    display_name = DISPLAY_NAMES[method_key]

    common_name = 'one_pulse'

    pop_names = ['HG', 'Farmer']

    pop_labels = [
        'Hunter-gatherer',
        'Farmer'
    ]

    markers = ['^', 's']

    try:

        paths_bins = path.join(
            input_dir,
            common_name + '_bins'
        )

        paths_dat = path.join(
            input_dir,
            common_name + '_dat'
        )

        paths_pred = [
            path.join(
                input_dir,
                common_name + '_pred'
            )
        ]

        fp = FancyPlot.load(
            paths_bins,
            paths_dat,
            paths_pred,
            pop_names,
            [common_name]
        )

        pop_colors, theory_colors = fp.choose_colors(
            colors=[color, color]
        )

        scatter_handles = []

        for j, (
            pop,
            pcolor,
            t_colors
        ) in enumerate(
            zip(
                fp.populations,
                pop_colors,
                theory_colors
            )
        ):

            for theory, t_color in zip(
                pop.theories,
                t_colors
            ):

                theory.draw(
                    ax,
                    t_color,
                    bin_scale=fp.bin_scale
                )

            n = min(
                len(pop.bins),
                len(pop.data)
            )

            sc = ax.scatter(
                fp.bin_scale * pop.bins[:n],
                pop.data[:n],
                color=pcolor,
                marker=markers[j],
                s=2.5,
                zorder=3,
                label=pop_labels[j]
            )

            scatter_handles.append(sc)

        # -- Shared axis range --

        ax.set_yscale('log')

        ax.set_xlim(
            *TRACTS_XLIM
        )

        ax.set_ylim(
            bottom=TRACTS_YLIM_BOT,
            top=TRACTS_YLIM_TOP
        )

        # -- Force square axes box --

        ax.set_box_aspect(1)

        # -- Method name --

        ax.set_title(
            display_name,
            fontsize=6,
            pad=3
        )

        # ----------------------------------------------------------
        # T annotation
        #
        # IMPORTANT:
        # For AncestralPaths, "Bad Fit" is now in the TOP-RIGHT
        # corner of the panel.
        #
        # x = 0.93 and y = 0.93 are both axes coordinates,
        # so the text remains in the same corner regardless
        # of the y-axis scale.
        # ----------------------------------------------------------

        trans = blended_transform_factory(
            ax.transAxes,
            ax.transAxes
        )

        if method_key == 'ancestry_paths':

            ax.text(
                0.93,
                0.93,
                'Bad Fit',
                transform=trans,
                fontsize=5,
                va='top',
                ha='right',
                style='italic'
            )

        else:

            t_val = T_GENS.get(
                method_key
            )

            if t_val is not None:

                # Keep all other T annotations exactly as before:
                # x = 80 cM, y = 93% of the panel height.

                trans_t = blended_transform_factory(
                    ax.transData,
                    ax.transAxes
                )

                ax.text(
                    80,
                    0.93,
                    f'T = {t_val} gens',
                    transform=trans_t,
                    fontsize=5,
                    va='top',
                    ha='left',
                    style='italic'
                )

        # -- Axis labels / ticks --

        if not show_xlabel:

            ax.tick_params(
                labelbottom=False
            )

        else:

            ax.set_xlabel(
                'Tract Length (cM)',
                fontsize=6
            )

        if show_ylabel:

            ax.set_ylabel(
                'Number of Tracts',
                fontsize=6
            )

        ax.tick_params(
            labelsize=6
        )

        print(
            'Success:',
            display_name
        )

    except Exception as e:

        print(
            'ERROR:',
            display_name,
            e
        )

        ax.text(
            0.5,
            0.5,
            str(e),
            transform=ax.transAxes,
            ha='center',
            fontsize=4.5,
            wrap=True
        )

        ax.set_box_aspect(1)


# ==================================================================
# ASSEMBLE COMBINED FIGURE
# ==================================================================

def create_combined_figure(
    output_file='combined_HG_TRACTS_figure.pdf'
):

    # ---- HG data ----

    hg_file = (
        '../final_figures_data/'
        'hg_combined_tract_data.txt'
    )

    empirical, theoretical = (
        build_hg_plot_data(hg_file)
    )

    # Fixed y-range

    y_limits = (
        1e-5,
        1e-1
    )

    all_x = pd.concat(
        [
            empirical['bin_center'],
            theoretical['bin_center']
        ]
    )

    x_limits = (
        all_x.min() * 0.9,
        all_x.max() * 1.1
    )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Layout -- clockwise from top-right:
    #
    #   Right column (col 3, rows 0->3):
    #     row 0  mosaic
    #     row 1  rfmix
    #     row 2  gnomix
    #     row 3  recombmix
    #
    #   Bottom row:
    #     col 0  ancestral_paths
    #     col 1  ancestry_hmm
    #     col 2  simplai
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------

    right_col_methods = [

        {
            'key': 'mosaic',
            'input_dir': '../mosaic'
        },

        {
            'key': 'rfmix',
            'input_dir': '../rfmix'
        },

        {
            'key': 'gnomix',
            'input_dir': '../gnomix'
        },

        {
            'key': 'recombmix',
            'input_dir': '../recombmix'
        },
    ]

    bottom_row_methods = [

        {
            'key': 'ancestry_paths',
            'input_dir': '../ancestry_paths'
        },

        {
            'key': 'ancestry_hmm',
            'input_dir': '../ancestry_hmm'
        },

        {
            'key': 'simplai',
            'input_dir': '../simplai'
        },
    ]

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Figure
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------

    fig = plt.figure(
        figsize=(5.5, 5.5)
    )

    gs = gridspec.GridSpec(
        4,
        4,
        figure=fig,
        width_ratios=[
            1, 1, 1, 1
        ],
        height_ratios=[
            1, 1, 1, 1
        ],
        wspace=0.50,
        hspace=0.50,
    )

    # -- Big HG panel (rows 0-2, cols 0-2) --

    ax_hg = fig.add_subplot(
        gs[0:3, 0:3]
    )

    draw_hg_plot(
        ax_hg,
        empirical,
        theoretical,
        x_limits,
        y_limits
    )

    # -- Right column: col 3, rows 0-3 --

    for row, method in enumerate(
        right_col_methods
    ):

        ax = fig.add_subplot(
            gs[row, 3]
        )

        draw_tracts_panel(
            ax,
            method['input_dir'],
            method['key'],
            show_xlabel=(row == 3),
            show_ylabel=False,
        )

    # -- Bottom row: row 3, cols 0-2 --

    for col, method in enumerate(
        bottom_row_methods
    ):

        ax = fig.add_subplot(
            gs[3, col]
        )

        draw_tracts_panel(
            ax,
            method['input_dir'],
            method['key'],
            show_xlabel=True,
            show_ylabel=(col == 0),
        )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Save
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------

    fig.savefig(
        output_file,
        dpi=300,
        bbox_inches='tight'
    )

    plt.close()

    print(
        'Saved:',
        output_file
    )


# ==================================================================
# MAIN
# ==================================================================

if __name__ == '__main__':

    create_combined_figure()
    
#saves to combined_HG_TRACTS_figure.pdf so need to move to revision_figure4.pdf
```

```{r}
# FULL FIGURE: Manhattan + QQ + Replication + Enrichment panels

# REPLICATION FUNCTION
# (unchanged -- these panels have very few points and are cheap to
# keep as vector; no rasterization needed here)

make_chr_plot <- function(chrom, midpoint, show_legend = FALSE) {

  window_size <- 1e7

  combined <- bind_rows(
    z_score_data %>%
      filter(CHR == chrom & abs(POS - midpoint) < window_size) %>%
      mutate(dataset = "Discovery"),

    capture_z_score_data %>%
      filter(CHR == chrom & abs(POS - midpoint) < window_size) %>%
      mutate(dataset = "Replication 1"),

    rep_z_score_data %>%
      filter(CHR == chrom & abs(POS - midpoint) < window_size) %>%
      mutate(dataset = "Replication 2")
  )

  combined$POS_MB <- combined$POS / 1e6

  x_min <- (midpoint - window_size) / 1e6
  x_max <- (midpoint + window_size) / 1e6

  combined$dataset <- factor(combined$dataset,
                             levels = c("Discovery", "Replication 1", "Replication 2"))

  p <- ggplot(combined, aes(x = POS_MB, y = weighted_z, color = dataset)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.4) +

    geom_hline(yintercept = c(3, -3),
               linetype   = "dashed",
               color      = "black",
               linewidth  = 0.4) +

    geom_hline(yintercept = c(2.64, -2.64),
               linetype   = "solid",
               color      = "black",
               linewidth  = 0.4) +

    scale_color_manual(
      name   = "Dataset",
      values = c(
        "Discovery"     = "purple4",
        "Replication 1" = "darkgreen",
        "Replication 2" = "lightgreen"
      )
    ) +

    labs(x = "Position (Mb)", y = "Z-score") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(x_min, x_max)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
    theme(
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "bottom" else "none",
      axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      plot.margin     = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
    )

  # ---------- REGION BOX ----------
  gene_annotations <- data.frame(
    gene  = c("HLA", "FADS1", "FADS2", "SLC24A5"),
    CHR   = c(6, 11, 11, 15),
    start = c(29600000, 61570000, 61620000, 48420000),
    end   = c(33400000, 61590000, 61640000, 48440000)
  )

  pos_height <- c(2.8, 3.2)
  neg_height <- c(-3.2, -2.8)

  if (chrom == 6) {
    ann  <- gene_annotations %>% filter(CHR == 6)
    xmin <- ann$start / 1e6
    xmax <- ann$end   / 1e6
    ymin <- neg_height[1]
    ymax <- neg_height[2]
  } else {
    box_half_width <- 0.2
    xmin <- (midpoint / 1e6) - box_half_width
    xmax <- (midpoint / 1e6) + box_half_width

    if (chrom %in% c(11, 15)) {
      ymin <- pos_height[1]; ymax <- pos_height[2]
    } else {
      ymin <- neg_height[1]; ymax <- neg_height[2]
    }
  }

  p <- p +
    annotate("rect",
             xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax,
             ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax,
             fill = "black")

  return(p)
}


# REPLICATION PANELS (C-F) — PER3 dropped, no legend

p2 <- make_chr_plot(6,  30927867)
p3 <- make_chr_plot(11, 61906864)
p4 <- make_chr_plot(12, 44252015)
p5 <- make_chr_plot(15, 48433494)

rep_row <- plot_grid(
  p2, p3, p4, p5,
  ncol       = 4,
  labels     = c("C", "D", "E", "F"),
  label_size = 8,
  label_fontface  = "plain",
  align      = "h"
)

# Gene labels above C-F
rep_gene_labels <- c("HLA", "FADS1/2", "IRAK4", "SLC24A5")

# x positions: just to the right of each panel letter
x_label_positions <- seq(0.05, 0.78, length.out = 4)

rep_row_with_genes <- ggdraw(rep_row)
for (i in 1:4) {
  rep_row_with_genes <- rep_row_with_genes +

      size     = 7
    )
}



# ENRICHMENT DATA
# (unchanged -- bar charts, negligible file size contribution)

methods <- c("ancestry_hmm", "mosaic", "rfmix", "simplai","gnomix", "recombmix",
             "replication2", "replication1", "ancestry_paths")

full_paths <- c(
  "../final_figures_data/fig5_full_ancestry_hmm_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/fig5_full_mosaic_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/fig5_full_rfmix_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/fig5_full_simplai_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/fig5_full_gnomix_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/fig5_full_recombmix_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/fig5_full_replication2_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/fig5_full_replication1_output_ancestry_hmm.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/fig5_full_ancestry_paths_average_ancestry_output.txt"
)

subset_paths <- c(
  "../final_figures_data/fig5_ancestryhmm_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/fig5_mosaic_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/fig5_rfmix_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/fig5_simplai_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/fig5_gnomix_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/fig5_recombmix_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/fig5_replication2_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/fig5_replication1_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_figures_data/fig5_ancestry_paths_average_ancestry_output.txt"
)

# Two-letter codes matching methods order
two_letter_codes <- c("AH", "Mo", "RF", "SI", "GN", "RM", "R2", "R1", "AP")

regions <- data.frame(
  gene  = c("HLA",    "IRAK4",  "FADS",   "SLC24A5"),
  chr   = c(6,        12,       11,       15),
  start = c(30000000, 42252015, 59000000, 46105416),
  end   = c(33000000, 46252015, 65000000, 50105416)
)

enrich_results <- data.frame()

for (r in 1:nrow(regions)) {
  region <- regions[r, ]

  for (i in seq_along(methods)) {
    method <- methods[i]

    subset_data     <- read.table(subset_paths[i], header = TRUE)
    overall_subset  <- mean(subset_data$HGall, na.rm = TRUE)
    region_subset   <- mean(subset_data$HGall[
      subset_data$CHR == region$chr &
      subset_data$POS > region$start &
      subset_data$POS < region$end
    ], na.rm = TRUE)
    subset_enrichment <- region_subset - overall_subset

    full_data       <- read.table(full_paths[i], header = TRUE)
    overall_full    <- mean(full_data$HGall, na.rm = TRUE)
    region_full     <- mean(full_data$HGall[
      full_data$CHR == region$chr &
      full_data$POS > region$start &
      full_data$POS < region$end
    ], na.rm = TRUE)
    full_enrichment <- region_full - overall_full

    enrich_results <- rbind(enrich_results, data.frame(
      gene       = region$gene,
      method     = method,
      short_code = two_letter_codes[i],
      type       = c("Full", "Subset"),
      enrichment = c(full_enrichment, subset_enrichment)
    ))
  }
}


# ENRICHMENT FACTOR ORDERING

enrich_results$gene <- factor(enrich_results$gene,
                               levels = c("HLA", "FADS", "IRAK4", "SLC24A5"))

# Display order: 5 discovery methods then R1 then R2
display_order <- c("AH", "Mo", "RF", "SI", "GN", "RM","AP", "R1", "R2")
enrich_results$short_code <- factor(enrich_results$short_code,
                                     levels = display_order)

# Dataset group drives colour
enrich_results$ds_group <- case_when(
  enrich_results$short_code %in% c("AH", "Mo", "RF", "SI", "GN", "RM", "AP") ~ "Discovery",
  enrich_results$short_code == "R1"                               ~ "Replication 1",
  enrich_results$short_code == "R2"                               ~ "Replication 2"
)
enrich_results$ds_group <- factor(enrich_results$ds_group,
                                   levels = c("Discovery", "Replication 1", "Replication 2"))

ds_colours <- c(
  "Discovery"     = "purple4",
  "Replication 1" = "darkgreen",
  "Replication 2" = "#90ee90"
)


# ENRICHMENT PLOTS (G-J)
# Full  = solid fill + matching outline, dodged left
# Subset = open bar (alpha=0 fill) + matching outline, dodged right

gene_order           <- c("HLA", "FADS", "IRAK4", "SLC24A5")
panel_letters_enrich <- c("G", "H", "I", "J")

enrich_plots <- list()

for (g in seq_along(gene_order)) {
  gname <- gene_order[g]
  dat_g <- enrich_results %>% filter(gene == gname)

  dat_full   <- dat_g %>% filter(type == "Full")
  dat_subset <- dat_g %>% filter(type == "Subset")

  # Assign explicit dodge group ids so both layers dodge together
  dat_full$dodge_id   <- paste0(as.character(dat_full$short_code),   "_F")
  dat_subset$dodge_id <- paste0(as.character(dat_subset$short_code), "_S")

  dat_g$bar_fill <- ifelse(dat_g$type == "Full",
                            ds_colours[as.character(dat_g$ds_group)],
                            "white")

  ep <- ggplot(dat_g,
               aes(x = short_code, y = enrichment,
                   group = type)) +
    geom_bar(stat     = "identity",
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.6),
             width    = 0.5,
             linewidth = 0.4,
             aes(fill = bar_fill, colour = ds_group)) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    scale_colour_manual(name = "Dataset", values = ds_colours) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 7.5, linetype = "dotted",
               linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey40") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "HG Ancestry Enrichment") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 7) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title      = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 6),
      plot.margin     = margin(18, 5, 5, 5)
    )

  enrich_plots[[g]] <- ep
}


# ENRICHMENT ROW + PANEL LETTERS (G-J via ggdraw)

enrich_row_raw <- plot_grid(
  plotlist = enrich_plots,
  ncol     = 4,
  align    = "h",
  axis     = "tb"
)

x_enrich <- seq(0.03, 0.78, length.out = 4)

# SHARED LEGEND FOR G-J
# Colour = dataset group; Fill style = Full (solid) vs Subset (open)

legend_helper <- data.frame(
  short_code = factor(rep(display_order, each = 2), levels = display_order),
  type       = rep(c("Full", "Subset"), length(display_order)),
  enrichment = 0.1
)
legend_helper$ds_group <- case_when(
  legend_helper$short_code %in% c("AH","Mo","RF","SI", "GN", "RM","AP") ~ "Discovery",
  legend_helper$short_code == "R1"                          ~ "Replication 1",

legend_helper$dodge_id <- paste0(legend_helper$short_code, "_",
                                  substr(legend_helper$type, 1, 1))

legend_enrich <- cowplot::get_legend(

         aes(x = short_code, y = enrichment,
             fill = ds_group, colour = ds_group,

    scale_fill_manual(
      name   = "Dataset",

    ) +

      values = ds_colours
    ) +

      name   = "Sample set",

        override.aes = list(
          fill   = c("grey30", "white"),
          colour = c("grey30", "grey30"),

        )
      )
    ) +
    theme_void() +

      legend.text     = element_text(size = 6),
      legend.title    = element_text(size = 6, face = "plain"),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "lines")
    ) +

      fill   = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1)),
      colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1))
    )
)
```

```{r}
ancestry_paths_z_score_data <- read.table("../final_sup_figures_data/S1_ancestry_paths_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt", header = TRUE)

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)

# Read data
combined_data <- ancestry_paths_z_score_data

# Assign alternating purple shades per chromosome
combined_data$color <- ifelse(as.numeric(combined_data$CHR) %% 2 == 0, "#d35400", "#f5cba7")  # dark and light orange


# Get average index per chromosome
chr_positions <- combined_data %>%
  group_by(CHR) %>%
  summarise(chr_index = mean(index)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Gene label positions (x = previous chromosome, y = ±4)
gene_labels <- data.frame(
  gene = c("HLA", "FADS", "SLC24A5", "TMEM117"),
  CHR = c(6, 11, 14, 11),
  y = c(4, -3.7, -3.7, 4)
) %>%
  left_join(chr_positions, by = "CHR") %>%
  # Shift to previous chromosome’s index if possible
  mutate(CHR_prev = CHR - 1) %>%
  left_join(chr_positions, by = c("CHR_prev" = "CHR"), suffix = c("", "_prev")) %>%
  mutate(x = ifelse(!is.na(chr_index_prev), chr_index_prev, chr_index)) %>%
  select(gene, x, y)



# Create Manhattan plot
manhattan_plot <- ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = index, y = weighted_z, color = color)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(3, -3), color = "black", linetype = "solid") +

  # Add line labels (using annotate)
  annotate("text", x = max(combined_data$index) * 0.98, y = 3, label = "Z = 3", hjust = 1, vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = max(combined_data$index) * 0.98, y = -3, label = "Z = -3", hjust = 1, vjust = 1.3, size = 3) +

  
    # Gene annotations
  
  scale_color_identity() +
  labs(x = "Chromosome", y = "Average Z-score") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

# Prepare data for QQ plot
qq_data <- combined_data %>%
  dplyr::select(p_value = p_value) %>%
  mutate(p_value = as.numeric(p_value)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(p_value) & p_value > 0)

# Create QQ plot
qq_plot <- {
  n <- length(qq_data$p_value)
  observed <- -log10(sort(qq_data$p_value))
  expected <- -log10(ppoints(n))
  
  ggplot(data.frame(expected, observed), aes(x = expected, y = observed)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.6, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "gray40", linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(x = "Expected", y = "Observed") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 8)
    )
}

# Combine plots side by side using cowplot
combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  manhattan_plot,
  qq_plot,
  labels = c("A", "B"),
  label_size = 12,
  rel_widths = c(2.5, 1.5)
)

# Save to PDF
ggsave("revision_FigureS1.pdf", combined_plot, width = 8, height = 3.75)
```

```{r}
# FUNCTION TO READ FILES
read_method_file <- function(path, method) {
  df <- read.table(path, header=TRUE)
  colnames(df) <- c("sample", paste0("global_ancestry_", method))
  return(df)
}

# FUNCTION TO BUILD EACH PANEL
make_plot <- function(qp_df, method_df, method_name) {
  df_plot <- inner_join(qp_df, method_df, by = "sample")
  colnames(df_plot) <- c("sample","qpAdm","method_val")
  
  if (nrow(df_plot)==0 || all(is.na(df_plot$method_val))) {
    return(ggplot() + theme_void())
  }
  
  # stats
  R_val     <- cor(df_plot$qpAdm, df_plot$method_val)
  beta_val  <- coef(lm(method_val ~ qpAdm, df_plot))[2]
  delta_val <- mean(abs(df_plot$method_val - df_plot$qpAdm))
  
  # color
  point_color <- if (method_name == "ADMIXTURE") {
    colors["ADMIXED"]
  } else {
    colors[[method_name]]
  }
  
  ggplot(df_plot, aes(qpAdm, method_val)) +
    geom_point(alpha=0.8, size=1.5, color=point_color) +
    geom_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE, color="firebrick") +
    geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype="dashed") +
    annotate("text",
             x = 0.00, y = 0.70,
             label = bquote(R == .(round(R_val, 2))),
             hjust = 0, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text",
             x = 0.00, y = 0.50,
             label = bquote(beta == .(round(beta_val, 2))),
             hjust = 0, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text",
             x = 0.30, y = 0.10,
             label = bquote(Delta == .(round(delta_val, 2))),
             hjust = 0, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim=c(0,0.45), ylim=c(0,0.8)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.margin = margin(2,2,2,2),
      axis.title  = element_blank(),
      axis.text   = element_text(size=6)
    )
}

# BUILD PLOT MATRIX
plot_matrix <- list()
for(method in row_order){
  for(panel in col_order){
    paths <- panel_paths[[panel]]
    method_subset <- panel_methods[[panel]]
    
    # read panel inputs
    dfs <- map2(paths, method_subset, read_method_file)
    
    # get qpAdm df
    qp_idx <- which(method_subset=="qpadm")
    qp_df <- dfs[[qp_idx]]
    colnames(qp_df) <- c("sample","global_ancestry_qpadm")
    
    # handle rows that don't exist
    if(!(method %in% method_subset) || method=="qpadm"){
      plot_matrix[[length(plot_matrix)+1]] <- ggplot() + theme_void()
      next
    }
    
    method_idx <- which(method_subset == method)
    method_df <- dfs[[method_idx]]
    plot_matrix[[length(plot_matrix)+1]] <- make_plot(qp_df, method_df, method)
  }
}

# TOP AND LEFT LABELS
top_labels <- lapply(col_order, function(lab) ggdraw() + draw_label(lab, fontface="bold", size=12))


#try:
row_labels <- c(
  ADMIXTURE              = "ADMIXTURE",
  ancestry_paths         = "AncestralPaths",
  simplai                = "SimplAI",
  rfmix                  = "RFMix",
  rfmix_filtered         = "0.9 filtered",
  mosaic                 = "MOSAIC",
  mosaic_filtered        = "0.9 filtered",

)

left_labels <- lapply(row_order, function(m) {

    draw_label(
      row_labels[[m]],
      angle = 90,
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 10,
      vjust = 0.1,
      hjust = 0.5
    )
})



# ASSEMBLE GRID
panel_grid <- plot_grid(plotlist=plot_matrix, ncol=length(col_order), align="hv")
with_top <- plot_grid(plot_grid(plotlist=top_labels, ncol=length(col_order)), panel_grid, ncol=1, rel_heights=c(0.06,1))
```

```{r}
#Figure S3
qpadm_path <- "../final_sup_figures_data/qpadm_individual_CEU.txt"

# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)

# Base directories -- gnomix/recombmix live in a separate revision subfolder
base_path <- "../final_sup_figures_data"
revision_path <- "../final_sup_figures_data"

# Dataset file names (with their source directory)
dataset_files <- c(
  "1kg_ancestryhmm_output_global_ancestry.txt",
  "1kg_rfmix_output_global_ancestry.txt",
  "1kg_mosaic_output_global_ancestry.txt",
  "1kg_simplai_output_global_ancestry.txt",
  "1kg_gnomix_output_global_ancestry.txt",
  "1kg_recombmix_output_global_ancestry.txt"
)

dataset_dirs <- c(
  base_path,
  base_path,
  base_path,
  base_path,
  revision_path,
  revision_path
)

# Full dataset paths
dataset_paths <- file.path(dataset_dirs, dataset_files)

# Extract method names from first part of filename
dataset_names <- gsub("_output_global_ancestry.txt", "", dataset_files)
dataset_names <- gsub("^1kg_", "", dataset_names)

# Function to read and rename
read_and_process <- function(file_path, method_name) {
  df <- read.table(file_path, header = TRUE)
  colnames(df) <- c("sample", paste0("global_ancestry_", method_name))
  return(df)
}

# Read LAI datasets
dataset_list <- list()
for (i in seq_along(dataset_paths)) {
  dataset_list[[i]] <- read_and_process(dataset_paths[i], dataset_names[i])
}

# Read qpAdm separately
qpadm_df <- read_and_process(qpadm_path, "qpadm")

# Combine everything
combined_df <- reduce(c(dataset_list, list(qpadm_df)), 
                      function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "sample"))

# Keep only relevant columns
combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  select(sample, starts_with("global_ancestry_"))

# Remove NAs
combined_df <- na.omit(combined_df)

# Plot settings
base_font_size <- 10
plots <- list()
qpAdm_vals <- combined_df[["global_ancestry_qpadm"]]

for (method in dataset_names) {
  
  y_vals <- combined_df[[paste0("global_ancestry_", method)]]
  df_plot <- data.frame(qpadm = qpAdm_vals, method_val = y_vals)
  r_val <- cor(df_plot$qpadm, df_plot$method_val)
  delta_val <- mean(abs(df_plot$method_val - df_plot$qpadm))
  
  fit <- lm(method_val ~ qpadm, data = df_plot)
  beta_val <- coef(fit)[2]

  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = qpadm, y = method_val)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8, color = "steelblue", size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "firebrick", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", 
                color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
    annotate("text",
             x = 0.00, y = 0.60,
             label = bquote(R == .(round(r_val, 2))),
             hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text",
             x = 0.00, y = 0.50,
             label = bquote(beta == .(round(beta_val, 2))),
             hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text",
             x = 0.30, y = 0.10,
             label = bquote(Delta == .(round(delta_val, 2))),
             hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    labs(
      x = "qpAdm",
      y = "Global Ancestry",
      title = method
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = base_font_size) +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.5),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", 
                                size = base_font_size + 1, 
                                hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_font_size + 2),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_font_size, color = "black"),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 0.45), ylim = c(0, 0.7))

  plots[[length(plots) + 1]] <- p
}

# Combine panels -- now 6 methods; ncol=2 gives 3 rows (kept consistent
# with the original layout). Switch to ncol=3 for a 2x3 grid instead if
# you'd rather it stay wider than tall.
final_plot <- plot_grid(plotlist = plots, ncol = 2)

# Save as Figure_S3
ggsave("revision_FigureS3.pdf", final_plot, width = 6, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)


# Helper function

read_file <- function(path, colname, remove_rnd = FALSE) {
  df <- read.table(path, header = TRUE)
  
  # Standardize column names
  colnames(df) <- c("sample", colname)
  
  # Remove _rnd if needed
  if (remove_rnd) {
    df$sample <- gsub("_rnd$", "", df$sample)
  }
  
  return(df)
}


# Read datasets

# ADMIXTURE
admix_imp   <- read_file("../final_sup_figures_data/admixture_imputed.txt", "imputed")
admix_unimp <- read_file("../final_sup_figures_data/admixture_unimputed.txt", "unimputed", remove_rnd = TRUE)
admix_df <- inner_join(admix_unimp, admix_imp, by = "sample")
# qpAdm
qpadm_imp   <- read_file("../final_sup_figures_data/qpadm_imputed.txt", "imputed")
qpadm_unimp <- read_file("../final_sup_figures_data/qpadm_unimputed.txt", "unimputed", remove_rnd = TRUE)
qpadm_df <- inner_join(qpadm_unimp, qpadm_imp, by = "sample")
# AncestryHMM
ahmm_imp   <- read_file("../final_sup_figures_data/ancestry_hmm_output_global_ancestry.txt", "imputed")
ahmm_unimp <- read_file("../final_sup_figures_data/ancestry_hmm_unimputed_full.txt", "unimputed", remove_rnd = TRUE)

ahmm_df <- inner_join(ahmm_unimp, ahmm_imp, by = "sample")


# Plotting function

make_plot <- function(df, title_label) {
  
  r_val <- cor(df$unimputed, df$imputed)
  delta_val <- mean(abs(df$imputed - df$unimputed))
  fit <- lm(imputed ~ unimputed, data = df)
  beta_val <- coef(fit)[2]
  
  mean_unimp <- mean(df$unimputed)
  mean_imp   <- mean(df$imputed)
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = unimputed, y = imputed)) +
    geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "firebrick",
                se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
                linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    annotate("text",
             x = 0.00, y = 0.60,
             label = bquote(R == .(round(r_val, 2))),
             hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text",
             x = 0.00, y = 0.50,
             label = bquote(beta == .(round(beta_val, 2))),
             hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text",
             x = 0.30, y = 0.10,
             label = bquote(Delta == .(round(delta_val, 3))),
             hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text",
         x = 0.00, y = 0.67,
         label = bquote(bar(U) == .(round(mean_unimp, 3)) ~ "," ~ 
                        bar(I) == .(round(mean_imp, 3))),
         hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    labs(
      x = "Unimputed",
      y = "Imputed",
      title = title_label
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 0.45), ylim = c(0, 0.7))
}


# Generate plots

p1 <- make_plot(admix_df, "ADMIXTURE")
p2 <- make_plot(qpadm_df, "qpAdm")
p3 <- make_plot(ahmm_df, "AncestryHMM")

final_plot <- plot_grid(p1, p2, p3, ncol = 3)

ggsave("revision_FigureS4.pdf",
       final_plot,
       width = 6.5,
       height = 3,
       dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)

# FILE PATHS 

sex_file <- "../final_sup_figures_data/sex_ploidy.txt"

method_files <- c(
  "../final_sup_figures_data/chr_x_admixture.txt",
  "../final_sup_figures_data/chr_x_ancestryhmm.txt",
  "../final_sup_figures_data/chr_x_mosaic.txt",
  "../final_sup_figures_data/chr_x_simplai.txt",
  "../final_sup_figures_data/chr_x_rfmix.txt",
  "../final_sup_figures_data/chr_x_recombmix.txt",
  "../final_sup_figures_data/chr_x_gnomix.txt"
)
# READ SEX FILE
sex_df <- read.table(sex_file, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(sex_df) <- c("sample", "ploidy", "ancestry_ref")

sex_df <- sex_df %>%
  mutate(
    sex = factor(ploidy, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Male", "Female"))
  )

# READ METHOD FILES
read_method <- function(file) {
  method_name <- file %>%
    basename() %>%
    gsub("^chr_x_", "", .) %>%
    gsub("\\.txt$", "", .)

  df <- read.table(file, header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  colnames(df) <- c("sample", "prop")

  df %>%
    mutate(method = method_name)
}

method_df <- map_dfr(method_files, read_method)

# ADD QPADM
qpadm_df <- read.table(
  "../final_sup_figures_data/x_qpadm_global.txt",
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
colnames(qpadm_df) <- c("sample", "prop")

qpadm_df <- qpadm_df %>%
  mutate(method = "X_qpadm")

method_df <- bind_rows(method_df, qpadm_df)

# MERGE WITH SEX
combined_df <- method_df %>%
  inner_join(sex_df %>% select(sample, sex), by = "sample")

# T-TESTS PER METHOD
ttest_df <- combined_df %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = tryCatch(
      t.test(prop ~ sex)$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_label = ifelse(is.na(p_value),
                     "p = NA",
                     paste0("p = ", signif(p_value, 3)))
  )

combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  left_join(ttest_df, by = "method")

# PLOTTING FUNCTION
plot_methods <- function(df, output_file) {

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = sex, y = prop, color = sex)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.3) +
    facet_wrap(~ method, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Male" = "steelblue",
                                  "Female" = "orange")) +
    geom_text(
      data = distinct(df, method, p_label),
      aes(x = 1.5, y = Inf, label = p_label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      vjust = 1.2,
      size = 3.2
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Sex",
      y = "X ancestry proportion",
      color = "Sex"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )

  ggsave(output_file, p, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)
}

# OUTPUT
plot_methods(
  combined_df,
  output_file = "revision_FigureS5.pdf"
)
```

```{r}
# LOAD LIBRARIES
library(tidyverse)


# FILE PATHS 

base_path <- "../final_sup_figures_data/"

inputs <- c(
  paste0(base_path, "rfmix_chr23_sex_tracts_by_sex_and_ancestry.txt"),
  paste0(base_path, "simplai_chr23_sex_tracts_by_sex_and_ancestry.txt"),
  paste0(base_path, "mosaic_chr23_sex_tracts_by_sex_and_ancestry.txt"),
  paste0(base_path, "ancestryhmm_chr23_sex_tracts_by_sex_and_ancestry.txt"),
  paste0(base_path, "gnomix_chr23_sex_tracts_by_sex_and_ancestry.txt"),
  paste0(base_path, "recombmix_chr23_sex_tracts_by_sex_and_ancestry.txt")
)

labels <- c("RFMix", "simpLAI", "Mosaic", "Ancestry HMM", "GNomix", "Recomb-Mix")


# SETTINGS

ancestry_labels <- list(
  "1" = list(name = "Farmer", color = "tab:blue"),
  "2" = list(name = "Hunter-gatherer", color = "tab:red")
)


# HELPERS

load_tracts <- function(path, ancestry) {
  df <- read.table(path, header = TRUE)

  df <- df %>% filter(ancestry == !!ancestry)

  males <- df %>%
    filter(sex == "male") %>%
    pull(tract_length_cm)

  females <- df %>%
    filter(sex == "female") %>%
    pull(tract_length_cm)

  # Optional filter (currently OFF, matches your Python script)
  # males <- males[males >= 1]
  # females <- females[females >= 1]

  list(males = males, females = females)
}

qq_points <- function(x, y, min_n = 10, num_points = 100) {

  x <- log10(x[x > 0])
  y <- log10(y[y > 0])

  if (length(x) < min_n || length(y) < min_n) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  percentiles <- seq(0, 1, length.out = num_points + 2)[-c(1, num_points + 2)]

  xq <- quantile(x, percentiles, na.rm = TRUE)
  yq <- quantile(y, percentiles, na.rm = TRUE)

  tibble(x = xq, y = yq)
}


# BUILD DATA FOR PLOTTING

plot_data <- map2_dfr(inputs, labels, function(path, label) {

  map_dfr(c(1, 2), function(anc) {

    tracts <- load_tracts(path, anc)
    qq <- qq_points(tracts$males, tracts$females)

    if (is.null(qq)) return(NULL)

    tibble(
      method = label,
      ancestry = ancestry_labels[[as.character(anc)]]$name,
      color = ancestry_labels[[as.character(anc)]]$color,
      x = qq$x,
      y = qq$y
    )
  })
})


# GET GLOBAL LIMITS FOR DIAGONAL

lims <- range(c(plot_data$x, plot_data$y), na.rm = TRUE)


# PLOT

p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = ancestry)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ method, ncol = 2, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Farmer" = "#1f77b4",
    "Hunter-gatherer" = "#d62728"
  )) +
  labs(
    x = "Male log10 tract length (cM)",
    y = "Female log10 tract length (cM)",
    color = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )


# SAVE
ggsave("revision_FigureS6.pdf", p, width = 4.5, height = 4.5)

```

```{r}
  AVG_simpLAI      = "simpLAI",

  AVG_gnomix       = "Gnomix"
)

colnames(cor_mat) <- rename_methods[colnames(cor_mat)]

# Cluster methods
hc <- hclust(as.dist(1 - cor_mat), method = "average")
ord <- hc$labels[hc$order]

cor_mat <- cor_mat[ord, ord]

# Convert to long format
cor_df <- melt(cor_mat, varnames = c("Method1", "Method2"),
               value.name = "Correlation")

cor_df$Method2 <- factor(cor_df$Method2, levels = rev(ord))
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(grid)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# FILE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

farmer_file <- "../final_figures_data/farmer_combined_tract_data.txt"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# COLORS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

method_colors <- c(
  "rfmix" = "red",
  "simplai" = "#e377c2",
  "mosaic" = "green",
  "gnomix" = "#8B4513",
  "recombmix" = "#B8860B",
  "ancestry_paths" = "#ff7f0e",
  "ancestry_hmm" = "#1f77b4"
)


method_names <- c(
  "rfmix" = "RFMix (7v7)",
  "simplai" = "simpLAI (7v3)",
  "mosaic" = "Mosaic (7v3)",
  "gnomix" = "Gnomix (7v7)",
  "recombmix" = "Recomb-Mix (7v7)",
  "ancestry_paths" = "AncestralPaths (7v48)",
  "ancestry_hmm" = "Ancestry HMM (7v7)"
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# READ FARMER TRACTS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

farmer <- read.table(
  farmer_file,
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


# Rename ancestry_hmm source
farmer$Source <- gsub(
  "ancestry_hmm_haplotypes",
  "ancestry_hmm",
  farmer$Source
)


# Remove zero lengths
farmer <- farmer %>%
  filter(tract_length_cm > 0)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# BIN EMPIRICAL TRACTS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

bin_edges <- logspace <- 10^seq(
  log10(0.5),
  log10(1000),
  length.out = 60
)

bin_centers <- (bin_edges[-1] + bin_edges[-length(bin_edges)]) / 2


farmer <- farmer %>%
  mutate(
    bin = cut(
      tract_length_cm,
      breaks = bin_edges,
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      labels = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(bin))


empirical <- farmer %>%
  count(Source, bin) %>%
  group_by(Source) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = n / sum(n),
    bin_center = bin_centers[bin]
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# THEORY CURVES
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

p_farmer <- 0.6   # complementary to HG=0.4

T_values <- c(10,20,50,100,200)


theory <- expand_grid(
  T = T_values,
  bin = seq_along(bin_centers)
) %>%
  mutate(
    bin_start = bin_edges[bin],
    bin_end = bin_edges[bin+1],
    lambda = (T*(1-p_farmer))/100,
    proportion = exp(-lambda*bin_start) -
                 exp(-lambda*bin_end),
    bin_center = bin_centers[bin]
  )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# PLOT
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

p <- ggplot() +

  # theory curves
  geom_line(
    data = theory,
    aes(
      x = bin_center,
      y = proportion,
      group = T
    ),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  # empirical farmer tracts
  geom_point(
    data = empirical,
    aes(
      x = bin_center,
      y = proportion,
      color = Source
    ),
    shape = 17,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = method_colors,
    labels = method_names
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0,250),
    breaks = c(0,50,100,150,200,250)
  ) +

  scale_y_log10(
    limits = c(1e-5,1e-1)
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Tract Length (cM)",
    y = "Proportion",
    color = NULL
  ) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +

theme(
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

  # move legend to upper-right
  legend.position = c(0.97, 0.97),
  legend.justification = c("right", "top"),

  # tighten legend spacing
  legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
  legend.key.height = unit(0.25, "cm"),
  legend.key.width = unit(0.25, "cm"),
  legend.spacing.y = unit(0.02, "cm"),
  legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),

  axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 10)
)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# SAVE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

ggsave(
  "revision_FigureS9.pdf",
  p,
  width = 5.5,
  height = 5.5,
  units = "in"
)
```
