```{r}

hg_tracts <- read.table("../final_figures_data/chrx_hg_combined_tract_data.txt", header = TRUE)
farmer_tracts <- read.table("../final_figures_data/chrx_farmer_combined_tract_data.txt", header = TRUE)


# Combined analysis for both populations
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
library(patchwork)  # Add this library for better plot combining

# Function to create plot data for a given population
create_plot_data <- function(pop_data, pop_name) {
  # Log-spaced bins from 1 to 1000 cM
  bin_edges <- 10^seq(log10(0.5), log10(1000), length.out = 60)
  
  # Filter out zeros and negative (tract length must be >0 for log binning)
  filtered_data <- pop_data %>%
    filter(tract_length_cm > 0)
  
  # Assign each tract to a bin
  filtered_data <- filtered_data %>%
    mutate(bin = cut(tract_length_cm, breaks = bin_edges, include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE))
  
  # Create a lookup table for bin centers
  bin_centers <- data.frame(
    bin = levels(cut(1, breaks = bin_edges, include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE)),
    bin_start = bin_edges[-length(bin_edges)],
    bin_end = bin_edges[-1]
  ) %>%
    mutate(bin_center = (bin_start + bin_end) / 2)
  
  # Population proportions
  p_farmer <- 0.6
  p_hg <- 0.4
  
  # Summarize counts per Source and bin
  binned_summary <- filtered_data %>%
    group_by(Source, bin) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    left_join(bin_centers, by = "bin") %>%
    filter(!is.na(bin_center))
  
  # Calculate total tracts per Source for empirical datasets
  total_counts_per_source <- binned_summary %>%
    group_by(Source) %>%
    summarise(total_count = sum(count))
  
  # Add proportion column for empirical data
  binned_summary <- binned_summary %>%
    left_join(total_counts_per_source, by = "Source") %>%
    mutate(proportion = count / total_count)
  
  # Define scaling factor based on population proportion
  p_pop <- ifelse(pop_name == "hg", p_hg, 
                  ifelse(pop_name == "farmer", p_farmer, NA))
  
  if (is.na(p_pop)) {
    stop("Population must be 'hg' or 'farmer' for theoretical scaling.")
  }
  
  # Generate continuous theoretical curves
  T_values <- seq(10, 200, by = 5)  # More continuous T values
  
  theoretical_data <- data.frame()
  
  # Define cutoff probability and calculate corresponding x-value for each T
  cutoff_prob <- 1e-5
  
  for (T in T_values) {
    lambda_rate <- (T * (1 - p_pop)) / 100
    
    # Calculate x-value where probability drops to cutoff_prob
    # For exponential: prob = exp(-lambda * x), so x = -log(prob) / lambda
    cutoff_x <- -log(cutoff_prob) / lambda_rate
    
    # Filter bin_centers to only include those up to cutoff_x
    filtered_bins <- bin_centers %>%
      filter(bin_center <= cutoff_x)
    
    # Add the exact cutoff point
    if(nrow(filtered_bins) > 0) {
      theory_bin_data <- filtered_bins %>%
        mutate(
          bin_probability = (exp(-lambda_rate * bin_start) - exp(-lambda_rate * bin_end)),
          Source = paste0("Theory T=", T),
          T_value = T
        )
      
      # Add the exact cutoff point
      cutoff_point <- data.frame(
        bin = NA,
        bin_start = cutoff_x,
        bin_end = cutoff_x,
        bin_center = cutoff_x,
        bin_probability = cutoff_prob,
        Source = paste0("Theory T=", T),
        T_value = T
      )
      
      theory_bin_data <- rbind(theory_bin_data, cutoff_point)
      theoretical_data <- rbind(theoretical_data, theory_bin_data)
    }
  }
  
  # Rename methods for colors
  change_color_names <- c(
    "rfmix" = "rfmix",
    "ancestry_paths" = "ancestry_paths",
    "ancestry_hmm_haplotypes" = "ancestry_hmm",
    "simplai" = "simplai",
    "mosaic" = "mosaic",
    "recombmix" = "recombmix",
  "gnomix" = "gnomix"
  )
  
  binned_summary$Source <- sapply(binned_summary$Source, function(x) {
    if (x %in% names(change_color_names)) {
      change_color_names[[x]]
    } else {
      x
    }
  })
  
  # Combine empirical and theoretical data
  empirical_data <- binned_summary %>% 
    select(Source, bin_center, proportion) %>% 
    rename(value = proportion) %>%
    mutate(type = "empirical")
  
  theoretical_plot_data <- theoretical_data %>% 
    select(Source, bin_center, bin_probability, T_value) %>% 
    rename(value = bin_probability) %>%
    mutate(type = "theoretical")
  
  # Filter theoretical data to only keep points with value >= 1e-5 (cutoff just below 0.00001)
  theoretical_plot_data <- theoretical_plot_data %>%
    filter(value >= 1e-5)
  
  list(empirical = empirical_data, theoretical = theoretical_plot_data)
}

# Create plot function
create_individual_plot <- function(plot_data_list, pop_name, y_limits, x_limits, show_x_title = TRUE, show_title = TRUE, point_shape = 16) {
  empirical_data <- plot_data_list$empirical
  theoretical_data <- plot_data_list$theoretical
  
  # Method names for labeling
method_names <- c(
  "rfmix" = "RFMix",
  "ancestry_paths" = "AncestralPaths",
  "ancestry_hmm" = "Ancestry HMM",
  "simplai" = "SimpLAI",
  "mosaic" = "Mosaic",
  "recombmix" = "Recomb-Mix",
  "gnomix" = "Gnomix"
)
  
  # Get empirical sources
  empirical_sources <- unique(empirical_data$Source)
  
  # Create base plot
  x_title <- if(show_x_title) "Tract Length (cM)" else ""
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    # Add theoretical curves for selected T values
    geom_line(data = theoretical_data %>% filter(T_value %in% c(10, 20, 50, 100, 200)),
              aes(x = bin_center, y = value, group = T_value),
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.8) +
    
    # Add empirical data points
    geom_point(data = empirical_data, 
               aes(x = bin_center, y = value, color = Source),
               shape = point_shape,
               alpha = 0.8, size = 1) +
    
    scale_x_log10(name = x_title, 
                  limits = x_limits,  # Use consistent x limits
                  breaks = c(1, 5, 20, 100, 500),
                  labels = c("1", "5", "20", "100", "500")) +
    scale_y_log10(name = "Proportion", 
                  limits = y_limits,
                  labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.00001, trim = TRUE)) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = colors[empirical_sources]) +
    theme_minimal() +
theme(
  legend.position = "right",
  legend.title = element_blank(),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
  legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
  plot.margin = margin(t = 1, r = 5, b = -1, l = 3),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
)
  
  # Add T value labels at the end of each curve (find the maximum x for each T line)
  theory_label_data <- theoretical_data %>%
    filter(T_value %in% c(10, 20, 50, 100, 200)) %>%
    group_by(T_value) %>%
    filter(bin_center == max(bin_center)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
# ---- T labels (smaller text) ----
p <- p + geom_text(
  data = theory_label_data,
  aes(x = bin_center, y = value, label = paste0("T=", T_value)),
  hjust = -0.05,
  vjust = 0.5,
  size = 1.8,
  color = "black"
)




  # Add panel label only if requested
  if(show_title) {
    panel_label <- ifelse(pop_name == "hg", "Hunter-Gatherer", "Farmer")
    p <- p + ggtitle(panel_label) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 7, face = "bold"))
  }
  
  return(p)
}

# Process both populations
hg_plot_data <- create_plot_data(hg_tracts, "hg")
farmer_plot_data <- create_plot_data(farmer_tracts, "farmer")

# Determine common y-axis and x-axis limits
all_empirical_values <- c(hg_plot_data$empirical$value, farmer_plot_data$empirical$value)
all_theoretical_values <- c(hg_plot_data$theoretical$value, farmer_plot_data$theoretical$value)
all_values <- c(all_empirical_values, all_theoretical_values)

# Set consistent limits
y_limits <- c(min(all_values) * 0.9, max(all_values) * 1.2)

# Get x-axis limits from both datasets
all_x_values <- c(hg_plot_data$empirical$bin_center, farmer_plot_data$empirical$bin_center,
                  hg_plot_data$theoretical$bin_center, farmer_plot_data$theoretical$bin_center)
x_limits <- c(min(all_x_values) * 0.9, max(all_x_values) * 1.1)

# Create individual plots with consistent limits
p_hg <- create_individual_plot(hg_plot_data, "hg", y_limits, x_limits, 
                              show_x_title = FALSE, show_title = FALSE, point_shape = 17)  # Triangle
p_farmer <- create_individual_plot(farmer_plot_data, "farmer", y_limits, x_limits, 
                                  show_x_title = TRUE, show_title = FALSE, point_shape = 15)  # Square

# Combine plots using patchwork
combined_plot <- p_hg / p_farmer
combined_plot <- p_hg / p_farmer +
  plot_layout(
    heights = c(1,1),
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    plot.margin = margin(1,2,0.3,2)
  )

# Save the plot
ggsave("revision_FigureS10.pdf", combined_plot, width = 4.5, height = 4)
```

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)

# ==========================================================
# INPUT FILES
# ==========================================================

discovery_file  <- "../final_figures_data/combined_weighted_z_scores.txt"
replication_file <- "../final_sup_figures_data/x_rep_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt"

# Only X:97.95 Mb region
regions <- matrix(
  c(
    23, 97945412
  ),
  ncol = 2,
  byrow = TRUE
)
colnames(regions) <- c("CHR", "POS")

window_size <- 10e6


# ==========================================================
# LOAD DATA
# ==========================================================

z_score_data <- read.table(discovery_file, header = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(CHR, POS, weighted_z)

rep_z_score_data <- read.table(replication_file, header = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(CHR, POS, weighted_z)


# ==========================================================
# PLOT FUNCTION
# ==========================================================

make_chr_plot <- function(chrom, midpoint, show_legend = FALSE) {

  rep_subset <- rep_z_score_data %>%
    filter(
      CHR == chrom,
      POS >= (midpoint - window_size),
      POS <= (midpoint + window_size)
    ) %>%
    mutate(dataset = "Replication")

  disc_subset <- z_score_data %>%
    filter(
      CHR == chrom,
      POS >= (midpoint - window_size),
      POS <= (midpoint + window_size)
    ) %>%
    mutate(dataset = "Discovery")

  combined <- bind_rows(rep_subset, disc_subset)

  combined <- combined %>%
    mutate(POS_MB = POS / 1e6)

  ggplot(
    combined,
    aes(
      x = POS_MB,
      y = weighted_z,
      color = dataset
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = c(-3, 3),
      linewidth = 0.4,
      colour = "black"
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = c(-1.96, 1.96),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.4,
      colour = "black"
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        Discovery = "purple4",
        Replication = "#56B4E9"
      )
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste0("Chr ", chrom, " (", round(midpoint / 1e6, 2), " Mb)"),
      x = "Position (Mb)",
      y = "Weighted Z-score",
      color = NULL
    ) +

    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +

    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "right" else "none"
    )
}


# ==========================================================
# BUILD FIGURE
# ==========================================================

plot1 <- make_chr_plot(
  regions[1,1],
  regions[1,2],
  show_legend = FALSE
)

legend <- cowplot::get_legend(
  make_chr_plot(
    regions[1,1],
    regions[1,2],
    show_legend = TRUE
  )
)

final_plot <- plot_grid(
  plot1,
  legend,
  rel_widths = c(1, 0.28)
)


# ==========================================================
# SAVE
# ==========================================================

ggsave(
  "revision_FigureS12.pdf",
  final_plot,
  width = 5,
  height = 3,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)

# ==========================================================
# FILES
# ==========================================================

dataset_paths <- c(
  "../final_sup_figures_data/ancestry_hmm_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_sup_figures_data/rfmix_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_sup_figures_data/simplai_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_sup_figures_data/mosaic_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_sup_figures_data/recombmix_average_ancestry_output.txt",
  "../final_sup_figures_data/gnomix_average_ancestry_output.txt"
)

dataset_names <- c(
  "ancestry_hmm",
  "rfmix",
  "simplai",
  "mosaic",
  "recombmix",
  "gnomix"
)

# Only X chromosome signal
regions <- matrix(
  c(
    23, 97945412
  ),
  ncol = 2,
  byrow = TRUE
)
colnames(regions) <- c("CHR", "POS")


# ==========================================================
# COLORS
# ==========================================================

method_colors <- c(
  ancestry_hmm = "#1f77b4",
  rfmix        = "#d62728",
  simplai      = "#e377c2",
  mosaic       = "#2ca02c",
  recombmix    = "#B8860B",
  gnomix       = "#8B4513"
)


# ==========================================================
# READ DATA
# ==========================================================

compute_zscore <- function(data) {
  data$new_z <- as.numeric(scale(data$HGall))
  data
}

read_dataset <- function(path, name) {

  df <- read.table(path, header = TRUE)
  colnames(df) <- c("CHR", "POS", "HGall")

  df <- df[order(df$CHR, df$POS), ]

  window_size <- 51
  out <- list()

  for (chr in unique(df$CHR)) {

    chr_data <- df[df$CHR == chr, ]
    n <- nrow(chr_data)

    means <- sapply(seq_len(n), function(i) {

      end <- min(i + window_size - 1, n)

      mean(chr_data$HGall[i:end], na.rm = TRUE)

    })

    out[[as.character(chr)]] <- data.frame(
      CHR = chr_data$CHR,
      POS = chr_data$POS,
      HGall = means,
      dataset = name
    )
  }

  out <- bind_rows(out)

  compute_zscore(out)
}

full_dataset <- bind_rows(

  lapply(seq_along(dataset_paths), function(i) {

    read_dataset(dataset_paths[i], dataset_names[i])

  })

)


# ==========================================================
# PLOT FUNCTION
# ==========================================================

make_region_plot <- function(chrom, midpoint) {

  window_size <- 10e6

  region_data <- full_dataset %>%
    filter(
      CHR == chrom,
      POS >= (midpoint - window_size),
      POS <= (midpoint + window_size)
    ) %>%
    mutate(POS_MB = POS / 1e6)

  p <- ggplot(
    region_data,
    aes(
      x = POS_MB,
      y = new_z,
      color = dataset
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = c(-3, 3),
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = method_colors) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Chr ", chrom, " (", round(midpoint/1e6, 2), " Mb)"),
      x = "Position (Mb)",
      y = "Z-score"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold"
      ),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )

  # gene box

  xmin <- (midpoint / 1e6) - 0.2
  xmax <- (midpoint / 1e6) + 0.2

  p +
    annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = xmin,
      xmax = xmax,
      ymin = -3.2,
      ymax = -2.8,
      fill = "black"
    )
}


# ==========================================================
# BUILD FIGURE
# ==========================================================

plot1 <- make_region_plot(
  regions[1, 1],
  regions[1, 2]
)

legend <- cowplot::get_legend(

  plot1 +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(size = 3)
      )
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_blank()
    )

)

final_plot <- plot_grid(

  plot1 +
    theme(legend.position = "none"),

  legend,

  rel_widths = c(1, 0.32)

)


ggsave(
  "revision_FigureS13.pdf",
  final_plot,
  width = 5,
  height = 3,
  dpi = 300
)
```

#Figure S15:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)

# INPUT FILES

discovery_file  <- "../final_sup_figures_data/figs12_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt"
replication_file <- "../final_sup_figures_data/rfmix7v7_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt"

# Four replicated regions
regions <- matrix(
  c(
    6, 30927867,
    11, 61906864,
    12, 44113667,
    15, 48433494
  ),
  ncol = 2,
  byrow = TRUE
)
colnames(regions) <- c("CHR", "POS")

window_size <- 10e6


# LOAD DATA

disc_data <- read.table(discovery_file, header = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(CHR, POS, weighted_z)

rep_data <- read.table(replication_file, header = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(CHR, POS, weighted_z)


# PLOT FUNCTION

make_region_plot <- function(chrom, midpoint, show_legend = FALSE) {

  rep_subset <- rep_data %>%
    filter(
      CHR == chrom,
      POS >= midpoint - window_size,
      POS <= midpoint + window_size
    ) %>%
    mutate(dataset = "RFMix 7v7")

  disc_subset <- disc_data %>%
    filter(
      CHR == chrom,
      POS >= midpoint - window_size,
      POS <= midpoint + window_size
    ) %>%
    mutate(dataset = "Discovery")

  combined <- bind_rows(rep_subset, disc_subset) %>%
    mutate(POS_MB = POS / 1e6)

  p <- ggplot(
    combined,
    aes(POS_MB, weighted_z, color = dataset)
  ) +

    geom_point(size = 0.6) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = c(3, -3),
      color = "black"
    ) +

    geom_hline(
      yintercept = c(2.24, -2.24),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "black"
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        Discovery = "purple4",
        `RFMix 7v7` = "#56B4E9"
      ),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +

    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "Chr ", chrom,
        " (", round(midpoint/1e6, 2), " Mb)"
      ),
      x = "Position (Mb)",
      y = "Z-score",
      color = NULL
    ) +

    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "right" else "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        face = "bold",
        size = 8
      )
    )

  # HLA annotation box
  if (chrom == 6) {
    xmin <- 29.6
    xmax <- 33.4
  } else {
    xmin <- midpoint / 1e6 - 0.2
    xmax <- midpoint / 1e6 + 0.2
  }

  p +
    annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = xmin,
      xmax = xmax,
      ymin = -3.2,
      ymax = -2.8,
      fill = "black"
    )
}


# BUILD PLOTS

plot_list <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(regions)),
  function(i)
    make_region_plot(
      regions[i, 1],
      regions[i, 2]
    )
)


# SINGLE LEGEND

legend_plot <- make_region_plot(
  regions[1,1],
  regions[1,2],
  show_legend = TRUE
)

      )
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm")
    )
)

plot_list <- lapply(
  plot_list,
  function(p) p + theme(legend.position = "none")
)


# PANEL LAYOUT

panel <- plot_grid(
  plotlist = plot_list,
  ncol = 2,
  labels = LETTERS[1:4],
  label_size = 9
)


# FINAL FIGURE

final_plot <- plot_grid(
  panel,
  legend,
  ncol = 2,
  rel_widths = c(1, 0.25)
)


# SAVE

ggsave(
  "revision_FigureS15.pdf",
  final_plot,
  width = 6,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

#Figure S16:

```{r}

# ==============================================================
# FIGURE S16: Manhattan + QQ
#
# High-quality publication PDF:
# - SNP point layers rasterized at 600 dpi using ggrastr
# - All text, axes, threshold lines, etc. remain vector
# - cairo_pdf used for final PDF output
# ==============================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(cowplot)
library(grid)
library(ggrastr)

# --------------------------------------------------------------
# LOAD DATA
# --------------------------------------------------------------

z_score_data <- read.table(
  "../final_sup_figures_data/S16_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt",
  header = TRUE
)

combined_data <- z_score_data

combined_data$CHR <- as.numeric(combined_data$CHR)


# --------------------------------------------------------------
# COLORS
# --------------------------------------------------------------

combined_data$color <- ifelse(
  combined_data$CHR %% 2 == 0,
  "#9b59b6",
  "#d2b4de"
)


# --------------------------------------------------------------
# CHROMOSOME POSITIONS
# --------------------------------------------------------------

chr_positions <- combined_data %>%
  group_by(CHR) %>%
  summarise(
    chr_index = mean(index),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# --------------------------------------------------------------
# GENE LABEL POSITIONS
# --------------------------------------------------------------

gene_labels <- data.frame(
  gene = c(
    "HLA",
    "FADS",
    "SLC24A5",
    "TMEM117"
  ),
  CHR = c(
    6,
    11,
    14,
    11
  ),
  y = c(
    4,
    -3.7,
    -3.7,
    4
  )
) %>%
  left_join(
    chr_positions,
    by = "CHR"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    CHR_prev = CHR - 1
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    chr_positions,
    by = c("CHR_prev" = "CHR"),
    suffix = c("", "_prev")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    x = ifelse(
      !is.na(chr_index_prev),
      chr_index_prev,
      chr_index
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    gene,
    x,
    y
  )


# ==============================================================
# MANHATTAN PLOT
#
# IMPORTANT:
# Only the SNP points are rasterized.
# Everything else remains vector.
# ==============================================================

manhattan_plot <- ggplot(
  combined_data,
  aes(
    x = index,
    y = weighted_z,
    color = color
  )
) +

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Rasterized SNP points
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  rasterize(
    geom_point(size = 0.7),
    dpi = 600
  ) +

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Z-score threshold lines -- VECTOR
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(3, -3),
    color = "black",
    linetype = "solid"
  ) +

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Threshold labels -- VECTOR
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = max(combined_data$index) * 0.98,
    y = 3,
    label = "Z = 3",
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 3
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = max(combined_data$index) * 0.98,
    y = -3,
    label = "Z = -3",
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = 1.3,
    size = 3
  ) +

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gene labels
  #
  # Currently commented out, matching your original S16.
  # Uncomment if you want them.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  # geom_text(
  #   data = gene_labels,
  #   aes(
  #     x = x,
  #     y = y,
  #     label = gene
  #   ),
  #   inherit.aes = FALSE,
  #   size = 3.2,
  #   fontface = "italic",
  #   vjust = ifelse(
  #     gene_labels$y > 0,
  #     -0.3,
  #     1.3
  #   )
  # ) +

  scale_color_identity() +

  labs(
    x = "Chromosome",
    y = "Average Z-score"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(
    base_size = 11
  ) +

  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(
      10,
      10,
      10,
      10
    )
  )


# ==============================================================
# QQ PLOT
#
# Again, ONLY the points are rasterized.
# The diagonal line and all text remain vector.
# ==============================================================

qq_data <- combined_data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    p_value = p_value
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_value = as.numeric(p_value)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(p_value),
    p_value > 0
  )


n <- length(
  qq_data$p_value
)

observed <- -log10(
  sort(qq_data$p_value)
)

expected <- -log10(
  ppoints(n)
)


qq_plot <- ggplot(
  data.frame(
    expected,
    observed
  ),
  aes(
    x = expected,
    y = observed
  )
) +

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Rasterized QQ points
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  rasterize(
    geom_point(
      size = 0.6,
      alpha = 0.6
    ),
    dpi = 600
  ) +

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # QQ reference line -- VECTOR
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    color = "gray40",
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Expected",
    y = "Observed"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(
    base_size = 10
  ) +

  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(
      10,
      10,
      10,
      10
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 9
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 8
    )
  )


# ==============================================================
# COMBINE A + B
# ==============================================================

combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  manhattan_plot,
  qq_plot,
  labels = c(
    "A",
    "B"
  ),
  label_size = 12,
  label_fontface = "plain",
  rel_widths = c(
    2.5,
    1.5
  )
)


# ==============================================================
# SAVE
#
# cairo_pdf keeps vector text/lines and embeds the rasterized
# point layers cleanly.
#
# dpi = 600 is already specified for the rasterized layers.
# ==============================================================

ggsave(
  "revision_FigureS16.pdf",
  combined_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 3.75,
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```

```{r}
  left_join(

    by = c("CHR_prev" = "CHR"),
    suffix = c("", "_prev")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    x = ifelse(
      !is.na(chr_index_prev),
      chr_index_prev,
      chr_index
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    gene,
    x,
    y
  )


# ==============================================================
# MANHATTAN PLOT
# ==============================================================

manhattan_plot <- ggplot(
  combined_data,
  aes(
    x = index,
    y = weighted_z,
    color = color
  )
) +

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Rasterize ONLY the SNP points
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  rasterize(
    geom_point(size = 0.7),
    dpi = 600
  ) +

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Z-score threshold lines -- VECTOR
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(3, -3),
    color = "black",
    linetype = "solid"
  ) +

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Threshold labels -- VECTOR
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = max(combined_data$index) * 0.98,
    y = 3,
    label = "Z = 3",
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 3
  ) +

  annotate(
    "text",
    x = max(combined_data$index) * 0.98,
    y = -3,
    label = "Z = -3",
    hjust = 1,
    vjust = 1.3,
    size = 3
  ) +

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gene annotations -- currently commented out,
  # exactly as in your original S17.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  # geom_text(
  #   data = gene_labels,
  #   aes(
  #     x = x,
  #     y = y,
  #     label = gene
  #   ),
  #   inherit.aes = FALSE,
  #   size = 3.2,
  #   fontface = "italic",
  #   vjust = ifelse(
  #     gene_labels$y > 0,
  #     -0.3,
  #     1.3
  #   )
  # ) +

  scale_color_identity() +

  labs(
    x = "Chromosome",
    y = "Average Z-score"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(
    base_size = 11
  ) +

  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(
      10,
      10,
      10,
      10
    )
  )


# ==============================================================
# QQ PLOT
# ==============================================================

qq_data <- combined_data %>%
  dplyr::select(
    p_value = p_value
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_value = as.numeric(p_value)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(p_value),
    p_value > 0
  )


n <- length(
  qq_data$p_value
)

observed <- -log10(
  sort(qq_data$p_value)
)

expected <- -log10(
  ppoints(n)
)


qq_plot <- ggplot(
  data.frame(
    expected,
    observed
  ),
  aes(
    x = expected,
    y = observed
  )
) +

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Rasterize ONLY the QQ points
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  rasterize(
    geom_point(
      size = 0.6,
      alpha = 0.6
    ),
    dpi = 600
  ) +

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Reference line -- VECTOR
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    color = "gray40",
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Expected",
    y = "Observed"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(
    base_size = 10
  ) +

  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(
      10,
      10,
      10,
      10
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 9
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 8
    )
  )


# ==============================================================
# COMBINE A + B
# ==============================================================

combined_plot <- plot_grid(
  manhattan_plot,
  qq_plot,
  labels = c(
    "A",
    "B"
  ),
  label_size = 12,
  label_fontface = "plain",
  rel_widths = c(
    2.5,
    1.5
  )
)


# ==============================================================
# SAVE PUBLICATION-QUALITY PDF
# ==============================================================

ggsave(
  "revision_FigureS17.pdf",
  combined_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 3.75,
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```

#Supplementary Tables:


#Table S1:


```{r}
library(tidyverse)

  
# 0. Load data
  

# Discovery dataset
z_score_data <- read.table("../final_figures_data/dis_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt", header = TRUE)

# replication datasets
rep_z_score_data <- read.table("../final_figures_data/rep2_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt", header = TRUE)
capture_z_score_data <- read.table("../final_figures_data/rep1_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt", header = TRUE)


  
# 1. Keep autosomes only
  

z_score_data <- z_score_data %>% filter(CHR %in% 1:22)
rep_z_score_data <- rep_z_score_data %>% filter(CHR %in% 1:22)
capture_z_score_data <- capture_z_score_data %>% filter(CHR %in% 1:22)

  
# 2. Filter |Z| > 3 in discovery
  

discovery_hits <- z_score_data %>%
  filter(abs(weighted_z) > 3) %>%
  arrange(CHR, POS)

  
# 3. Collapse regions within 3 Mb
  

collapse_hits <- function(df, window = 3e6) {
  
  df <- df %>% arrange(CHR, POS)
  kept <- list()
  
  for(chr in unique(df$CHR)) {
    
    chr_df <- df %>% filter(CHR == chr)
    
    while(nrow(chr_df) > 0) {
      
      lead <- chr_df[1, ]
      
      region <- chr_df %>%
        filter(abs(POS - lead$POS) <= window)
      
      # Keep lowest p-value
      best <- region %>% arrange(p_value) %>% slice(1)
      
      kept[[length(kept) + 1]] <- best
      
      chr_df <- chr_df %>%
        filter(abs(POS - best$POS) > window)
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(kept)
}

discovery_collapsed <- collapse_hits(discovery_hits, window = 3e6)

  
# 4. Replication function (2 Mb window ONLY)
  

find_replication <- function(row, rep_df, window = 2e6, p_thresh = 0.0083) {
  
  chr <- row$CHR
  pos <- row$POS
  
  chr_rep <- rep_df %>% filter(CHR == chr)
  
  hits <- chr_rep %>% filter(abs(POS - pos) <= window)
  
  if(nrow(hits) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  best <- hits %>% arrange(p_value) %>% slice(1)
  
  tibble(
    Replication_POS = best$POS,
    Replication_Z = best$weighted_z,
    Replication_P = best$p_value,
    Distance_bp = abs(best$POS - pos),
    Replication_Significant = best$p_value < p_thresh,
    Any_Significant_2Mb = any(hits$p_value < p_thresh)
  )
}

  
# 5. Build final table (Akbari + Capture)
  

results <- list()

for(i in 1:nrow(discovery_collapsed)) {
  
  disc <- discovery_collapsed[i, ]
  
  # Akbari replication
  rep_akbari <- find_replication(disc, rep_z_score_data)
  
  # Capture replication
  rep_capture <- find_replication(disc, capture_z_score_data)
  
  if(!is.null(rep_akbari) | !is.null(rep_capture)) {
    
    if(!is.null(rep_akbari)){
      rep_akbari <- rep_akbari %>%
        rename_with(~paste0("Akbari_", .))
    }
    
    if(!is.null(rep_capture)){
      rep_capture <- rep_capture %>%
        rename_with(~paste0("Capture_", .))
    }
    
    combined <- bind_cols(
      tibble(
        CHR = disc$CHR,
        Discovery_POS = disc$POS,
        Discovery_Z = disc$weighted_z,
        Discovery_P = disc$p_value
      ),
      rep_akbari,
      rep_capture
    )
    
    results[[length(results) + 1]] <- combined
  }
}

final_table <- bind_rows(results)

  
# 6. Optional summary column
  

final_table <- final_table %>%
  mutate(
    Replicated_in_any = coalesce(Akbari_Replication_Significant, FALSE) |
                        coalesce(Capture_Replication_Significant, FALSE)
  )

  
# 7. Save table
  


final_table_clean <- final_table %>%
  transmute(
    CHR,
    
    # Discovery
    Discovery_POS,
    Discovery_Z,
    Discovery_P,
    
        # Rep1 (formerly Capture)
    Rep1_Z = Capture_Replication_Z,
    Rep1_P = Capture_Replication_P,
    Replicated_Rep1 = coalesce(Capture_Replication_Significant, FALSE),
    
    # Rep2 (formerly Akbari)
    Rep2_Z = Akbari_Replication_Z,
    Rep2_P = Akbari_Replication_P,
    Replicated_Rep2 = coalesce(Akbari_Replication_Significant, FALSE)
    
  )

write.table(final_table_clean,
            "revision_Table_S1.txt",
            quote = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE,
            sep = "\t")
```




#Table S3:

```{r}

#table S3

#X chromosome and replication 

#Hits reaching a threshold of Z is greater than 3 or less than -3 on the X 

library(tidyverse)

# Load data
z_score_data <- read.table(
  "../final_figures_data/combined_weighted_z_scores.txt",
  header = TRUE
)

rep_z_score_data <- read.table(
  "../final_sup_figures_data/x_rep_combined_weighted_z_scores.txt",
  header = TRUE
)

 
# 1. Keep autosomes only
 

#z_score_data <- z_score_data %>% filter(CHR %in% 1:22)
#rep_z_score_data <- rep_z_score_data %>% filter(CHR %in% 1:22)

 
# 2. Filter |Z| > 3 in discovery
 

discovery_hits <- z_score_data %>%
  filter(abs(weighted_z) > 3) %>%
  arrange(CHR, POS)

 
# 3. Collapse regions within 3 Mb
 

collapse_hits <- function(df, window = 3e6) {
  
  df <- df %>% arrange(CHR, POS)
  kept <- list()
  
  for(chr in unique(df$CHR)) {
    
    chr_df <- df %>% filter(CHR == chr)
    
    while(nrow(chr_df) > 0) {
      
      lead <- chr_df[1, ]
      
      region <- chr_df %>%
        filter(abs(POS - lead$POS) <= window)
      
      # Keep lowest p-value
      best <- region %>% arrange(p_value) %>% slice(1)
      
      kept[[length(kept) + 1]] <- best
      
      chr_df <- chr_df %>%
        filter(abs(POS - best$POS) > window)
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(kept)
}

discovery_collapsed <- collapse_hits(discovery_hits, window = 3e6)

 
# 4. Find replication matches
 

find_replication <- function(row, rep_df, strict_window = 250000, broad_window = 2000000, p_thresh = 0.05) {
  
  chr <- row$CHR
  pos <- row$POS
  
  chr_rep <- rep_df %>% filter(CHR == chr)
  
  # Compute both windows first
  tight <- chr_rep %>% filter(abs(POS - pos) <= strict_window)
  loose <- chr_rep %>% filter(abs(POS - pos) <= broad_window)
  
  # Choose best hit
  if(nrow(tight) > 0) {
    best <- tight %>% arrange(p_value) %>% slice(1)
    window_type <- "250kb"
  } else if(nrow(loose) > 0) {
    best <- loose %>% arrange(p_value) %>% slice(1)
    window_type <- "2Mb"
  } else {
    return(NULL) # no replication hit found
  }
  
  distance_bp <- abs(best$POS - pos)
  
  # Check if any replication hit in windows has p < threshold
  sig_250kb <- any(tight$p_value < p_thresh)
  sig_2Mb   <- any(loose$p_value < p_thresh)
  
  tibble(
    Replication_POS = best$POS,
    Replication_Z = best$weighted_z,
    Replication_P = best$p_value,
    Distance_bp = distance_bp,
    Replication_Significant = best$p_value < p_thresh,
    Significant_250kb = sig_250kb,
    Significant_2Mb = sig_2Mb,
    Replication_Window = window_type
  )
}
 
# 5. Build final table
 

results <- list()

for(i in 1:nrow(discovery_collapsed)) {
  
  disc <- discovery_collapsed[i, ]
  rep_hit <- find_replication(disc, rep_z_score_data)
  
  if(!is.null(rep_hit)) {
    
    combined <- bind_cols(
      tibble(
        CHR = disc$CHR,
        Discovery_POS = disc$POS,
        Discovery_Z = disc$weighted_z,
        Discovery_P = disc$p_value
      ),
      rep_hit
    )
    
    results[[length(results) + 1]] <- combined
  }
}

final_table <- bind_rows(results)

 
# 6. Write table
 

write.table(final_table,
            "revision_Table_S3.txt",
            quote = FALSE,
            row.names = FALSE,
            sep = "\t")

```
